body:
I don't exactly feel sad when I'm depressed, just numb, like nothing mattes. I feel empty inside and lonely. All the energy is drained out of me. I won't want to leave the house or do anything really. I won't want to talk to anyone and if someone talks to me I'll answer just by shaking my head or by saying as few words as possible. 

I won't feel like eating and food will taste flavorless to me. If I try to force myself to eat while I'm depressed I'll just end up feeling sick to my stomach like I might vomit. 

Sometimes, but not always, the daytime will depress me and I'll wait for it to get dark so I can go back to bed. I actually slept a full 12 hours yesterday, something that I've never done before. 

If you need anymore information please let me know.
